findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Inspector observed an employee wash and lather hands, then turn off the faucet before using paper towels. CORRECTED- education was provided. Review hand washing procedures with staff, a paper towel should be used to dry hands and THEN turn off the faucet after hand washing to avoid re-contaminating hands.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door. [C]

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: Inspector observed egg rolls and fried chicken in the standing cooler without covering. CORRECTED- plastic wrap was placed over the foods. Ensure foods in cooling units are covered to protect from contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(4) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (4) Except as specified under Subparagraph 3-501.15(B)(2) and in (B) of this section, storing the food in packages, covered containers, or wrappings. [C]

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Inspector observed unwashed produce stored on the floor in the walk in cooler. Store foods at least 6 inches above the ground to protect against contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor. [C]

findings.title: No bare-hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a to-go soup bowl submerged in the soy sauce. CORRECTED- the person in charge (PIC) removed the bowl to be discarded, and replaced with a ladel. Education occurred regarding the need for a scoop with a handle to prevent potential bare hand contamination of ready to eat (RTE) foods.
findings.citation_text: 3-301.11(B) Preventing Contamination from Hands. (B) Except when washing fruits and vegetables as specified under §3-302.15 or as specified in (D) and (E) of this section, FOOD EMPLOYEES may not contact exposed, READY-TO-EAT FOOD with their bare hands and shall use suitable UTENSILS such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, single-use gloves, or dispensing EQUIPMENT. [P]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: The soap in the back hand washing sink was observed to be not properly dispensing. CORRECTED- a hand soap pump was brought to the hand washing sink. Ensure hand washing sinks are always supplied with accessible soap for proper hand washing.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.11 Handwashing Cleanser, Availability. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. [P]

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment: FIRST REPEAT: A total of four cans (a mixture of soy sauce and oyster sauce) were observed to contain dents along the seams. CORRECTED- The PIC voluntarily used post-it notes to mark the dented cans with a large “X” to be sent back to their supplier. The PIC stated the kitchen manager stocks the shelves, and communicated this new procedure to them. Ensure seams of cans are not dented to prevent the entry and growth of Botulism. Mark and move these cans aside in the future.
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants. [Pf]

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored.
findings.comment: FIRST REPEAT: Inspector observed wet wiping cloths out in the front area as well as in the kitchen. CORRECTED- Person in charge moved cloth to sanitizer bucket before inspector was able to discuss item. Ensure wiping cloths are stored in sanitizer buckets in between uses to prevent the growth and harborage of bacteria.
findings.citation_text: 3-304.14(B) Wiping Cloths, Use Limitation. (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and other EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be: (1) Held between uses in a chemical sanitizer solution at a concentration specified under § 4-501.114. [C]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Inspector observed shelves within the walk in cooler to contain an accumulation of rust and other debris. Nonfood contact surfaces should be cleaned at a frequency to prevent the accumulation of soil debris. Ensure shelves are either cleaned painted/sealed (made to be smooth and easily cleanable) or replaced by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris. [C]

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment: A total of 4 ketchup cans were observed to have dents along the seams of the cans. CORRECTED- Person in charge voluntarily removed can and will send back to supplier. Ensure seams of cans are not dented to prevent bacterial growth.
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants. [Pf]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed food debris on ready to use vegetable chopper. CORRECTED- Person in charge removed utensil to be cleaned and sanitized. Ensure utensils are cleaned after each use and are maintained clean to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. [Pf]

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a wet wiping cloth on the counter near the front hand sink. CORRECTED- Person in charge moved cloth to sanitizer bucket before inspector was able to discuss item. Ensure wiping cloths are stored in sanitizer buckets in between uses.
findings.citation_text: 3-304.14(B) Wiping Cloths, Use Limitation. (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and other EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be: (1) Held between uses in a chemical sanitizer solution at a concentration specified under § 4-501.114. [C]

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored.
findings.comment: Inspector observed knife on the kitchen prep table (near rice) to be suspended between two tables. CORRECTED- Person in charge removed the knife to be cleaned and sanitized. Food contact surfaces should be stored in such a manner to protect from contamination while in use.
findings.citation_text: 3-304.12(C) In-Use Utensils, Between-Use Storage. During pauses in FOOD preparation or dispensing, FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored:(C) On a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food-contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized at a frequency specified under §§ 4-602.11 and 4-702.11. [C]

findings.title: Utensils, equipment, and linens: properly stored, dried, and handled.
findings.comment: Inspector observed utensils storage container to contain food debris. CORRECTED- Person in charge removed utensil storage container to be cleaned and sanitized. Non-food contact surfaces should be cleaned at frequency to prevent accumulation of debris.
findings.citation_text: 4-903.11(A) Equipment, Utensils, Linens, and Single-Service and Single-Use Articles. (A) Except as specified in (D) of this section, cleaned EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, laundered LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be stored: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Paint around the front counter handsink is chipped and deteriorating. Repaint the walls around the front counter handsink so the wall is smooth and easily cleanable.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: There is a leak in the ceiling in the middle of the kitchen (not over any food prep/storage). Per PIC, the landlord has been notified and is getting estimates for repairs. In the meantime, a bucket has been placed to catch the drip. Repair the ceiling to eliminate the leak.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]
